correctness.rationale: The C^2-definable refinement gives constant predecessor-color degrees and successor-color across each stable class. Simultaneous indegree-zero peeling identifies cycle-only colors; the connected hypothesis forces a single cyclic permutation of colors, whose per-color cardinality determines the cycle repetition. Induction on peel stage reconstructs every incoming rooted tree. Matching stable histograms therefore reconstruct a unique isomorphism; the same automorphism/branch-swap argument identifies stable color classes with orbits. For the disconnected boundary, six-cycle and two triangles both have one outgoing and one incoming arc per vertex, no loops or reciprocal pairs; their full two-variable atomic neighbor counts agree. A no-collision canonical census to twelve points and exact orbit checks to seven points corroborate the symbolic argument but do not replace it.

value.rationale: Exact structural classification for every finite weakly connected monounary relational algebra, not only a low-order search: C^2 equivalence equals isomorphism and its stable color partition equals the orbit partition, with a concrete disconnected counterboundary. This distinguishes logical recognition on a natural connected species from general unary functions and yields a direct conceptual explanation via the unique directed cycle and attached trees.
